notes:
New in Settings: Brew Timer Start - First Drip (default), Pump Start or Main Extraction. The selected time is the one shown on the screen and the web page, used for the post-brew summary and flow, and reported to Grind-by-Sync. First Drip starts when the scale first shows coffee in the cup (inferred from weight, so it lags the real first drop slightly) and waits at 00:00 until then; if no drip is seen the summary says "No valid extraction time", gives no grind advice and nothing is reported to the grinder. The choice is saved and applies from the next shot.
